test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper marks his goods at 80% more than their cost price and allows a discount of 48% on the marked price. His loss percentage is:
solution: Given: The marked price = 80% above its cost price. Discount = 48% Concept used: SP = CP + profit Profit is calculated on the cost price and discount on the market price.
